quests.question: Asked if the policy had failed, the minister mumbled that 'challenges remain'; her answer was _____.
quests.explanation: Mumbling 'challenges remain' rather than saying yes or no avoids plain speech: mealy-mouthed.

quests.question: The teacher gave each child exactly one slice, dividing the cake _____.
quests.explanation: Giving each child exactly one slice means everyone got the same amount, so evenly fits.

quests.question: He grumbles from morning till night and is never once satisfied; he is _____ unhappy.
quests.explanation: Grumbling from morning till night and never being satisfied means all the time: perpetually.

quests.question: The jewellery glittered in the shop window but was cheap plastic; the display was _____.
quests.explanation: Glittering jewellery that is cheap plastic is attractive but false: meretricious.

quests.question: Told to switch off the game, he stuck out his lip and stomped off in silence, looking _____.
quests.explanation: A stuck-out lip and silent stomping show a bad-tempered pout, so sulky fits; cheerful contradicts.

quests.question: Mention his weight even gently and he snaps at you; he is very _____ about it.
quests.explanation: Snapping at even a gentle mention shows he is easily offended on that subject: touchy.

quests.question: The aunt rearranged our furniture, commented on our budget and phoned our friends; she is _____.
quests.explanation: Rearranging furniture, commenting on money and phoning friends show interfering in others' affairs: meddlesome.

quests.question: One minute he laughed, the next he slammed doors for no reason; he is so _____.
quests.explanation: Switching from laughter to door-slamming for no reason shows changing moods, so moody fits.

quests.question: 'All dogs bark, so anything that barks is a dog' is clearly _____ reasoning.
quests.explanation: Reversing the statement is faulty logic (seals bark too), which makes it fallacious.

quests.question: Seven-year-old Lia told everyone where to sit, what to play and when to stop; she is _____.
quests.explanation: Telling everyone where to sit, what to play and when to stop shows ordering others about: bossy.

quests.question: Forced to share his toys, the boy handed them over _____, glaring.
quests.explanation: Being forced and glaring show he gave them up with resentment, so begrudgingly fits.

quests.question: She has been late every day for two years; she is _____ late.
quests.explanation: Being late every day for two years is a long-lasting habit, so chronically fits; rarely contradicts.

quests.question: The aide's reviews were stuffed with flattery for the minister and nothing else; they sounded _____.
quests.explanation: Reviews filled with flattery and nothing else read as grovelling to win favour: sycophantic.

quests.question: He swore loyalty to the king, then sold the castle plans to the enemy; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Swearing loyalty and then selling secrets to the enemy is treacherous, so perfidious fits.

quests.question: The pop-ups blocked the screen and the app tracked our location constantly; its ads felt _____.
quests.explanation: Blocking the screen and constant tracking push into users' space, so intrusive fits.

quests.question: A mild joke about his hat made him storm off hurt; he is _____ to teasing.
quests.explanation: Storming off hurt over a mild joke shows he reacts far too strongly: hypersensitive.

quests.question: The toddler wouldn't leave Mum's leg and cried whenever she stepped away; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Holding on to Mum's leg and crying when she moves away shows over-attachment: clingy.

quests.question: She laughed, chatted and bounced around the room, radiating energy; she has a _____ personality.
quests.explanation: Laughing, chatting and bouncing with energy show a lively, effervescent nature: bubbly.

quests.question: She peeked through our curtains and asked what was in every parcel; the neighbour is _____.
quests.explanation: Peeking through curtains and quizzing about parcels shows excessive curiosity about others: nosy.

quests.question: He chooses her clothes, her friends and her schedule; he is deeply _____.
quests.explanation: Choosing her clothes, friends and schedule shows dominating her life: controlling.

quests.question: He hugged his grandson, ruffled his hair and kissed his forehead, greeting him _____.
quests.explanation: Hugging, ruffling hair and kissing a forehead show warm love, so affectionately fits.

quests.question: The boy stuck out his tongue at the headmaster, grinned and ran off; it was a _____ thing to do.
quests.explanation: Sticking out his tongue at the headmaster and running off is playfully disrespectful: cheeky.

quests.question: He laughed at every joke, praised every idea and bowed whenever the boss passed; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Laughing at every joke, praising every idea and bowing to the boss show grovelling flattery, so fawning fits.

quests.question: The 'grassroots' protest was organised and paid for by a firm; its enthusiasm was _____.
quests.explanation: A protest organised and paid for by a firm is artificial, not natural, so factitious fits.

quests.question: Though the story was fiction, she wept and had to leave the room, reacting _____.
quests.explanation: Weeping at fiction and leaving the room shows feelings ruling her reaction: emotionally.

quests.question: He checks her messages, hates her seeing friends and says she belongs to him; he is _____.
quests.explanation: Checking messages, resenting her friends and claiming she belongs to him show an urge to own: possessive.

quests.question: He picks out every pea, rejects crusts and refuses anything touching anything else; he's a very _____ eater.
quests.explanation: Picking out peas, rejecting crusts and refusing touching foods shows hard-to-please tastes: fussy.

quests.question: After the burglary, every creak made her gasp and spin round; she felt _____.
quests.explanation: Gasping and spinning at every creak after a burglary shows being on edge, so jumpy fits.

quests.question: She jumped to fetch coffee for any guest, calling each one 'sir'; her manner was _____.
quests.explanation: Fetching coffee for everyone and saying 'sir' to all shows over-eager submissiveness: servile.

quests.question: She twisted every conversation with fake tears and guilt to get her way; she is _____.
quests.explanation: Using fake tears and guilt to get her way shows controlling others by trickery: manipulative.
